metadata.question: Did the surface water extent of Lake Mead decrease between July 6, 2000 and July 3, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Lake Mead location: approximately 36.1°N, 114.5°W (Nevada/Arizona border) - Date 1: July 6, 2000 - Date 2: July 3, 2022 - Collection: Landsat 7 for 2000, Landsat 8/9 for 2022 - We need water extent, so we'll use water indices (NDWI or modified NDWI) 2. Masking strategy: - Use cloud masking (QA bands) to remove clouds - Apply water detection threshold on NDWI - Count water pixels in each period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Lake has some water pixels counted properly - C1: No images found for the dates/location - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare water extent: if 2022 < 2000, answer A (Yes, decreased); otherwise B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lake Mead geometry const lakeMead = ee.Geometry.Point([-114.5, 36.1]).buffer(15000); // 15km radius // 2. Data Acquisition for 2000 (Landsat 7) const col2000 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeMead) .filterDate('2000-07-01', '2000-07-10') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); const count2000 = col2000.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2000 Images found: ${count2000}`); if (count2000 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Data Acquisition for 2022 (Landsat 8/9) let col2022 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeMead) .filterDate('2022-07-01', '2022-07-10') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); let count2022 = col2022.size().getInfo(); if (count2022 === 0) { // Try Landsat 9 col2022 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeMead) .filterDate('2022-07-01', '2022-07-10') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); count2022 = col2022.size().getInfo(); } console.log(`2022 Images found: ${count2022}`); if (count2022 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Process 2000 data const img2000 = col2000.median(); const green2000 = img2000.select('SR_B2').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const nir2000 = img2000.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const ndwi2000 = green2000.subtract(nir2000).divide(green2000.add(nir2000)); const water2000 = ndwi2000.gt(0.0); // 5. Process 2022 data const img2022 = col2022.median(); const green2022 = img2022.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const nir2022 = img2022.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const ndwi2022 = green2022.subtract(nir2022).divide(green2022.add(nir2022)); const water2022 = ndwi2022.gt(0.0); // 6. Calculate water pixel counts const waterCount2000 = water2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMead, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B2').getInfo(); const waterCount2022 = water2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMead, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B3').getInfo(); console.log(`Water pixels 2000: ${waterCount2000}`); console.log(`Water pixels 2022: ${waterCount2022}`); // 7. Validation and answer if (waterCount2000 === null || waterCount2022 === null) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (waterCount2000 === 0 && waterCount2022 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } const decrease = waterCount2022 < waterCount2000; const percentChange = ((waterCount2022 - waterCount2000) / waterCount2000 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (decrease) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
